summary: Team-scoped payment trackers tested end-to-end (backend pytest 13/14 + Playwright UI at 390x844). Core feature works: team tracker counts 8/9 ($160 at $20), list ?team_id filter, duplicate keeps team_ids, member status/exclude responses team-scoped, /remind returns 200 and only targets the 7 unpaid Senior team members, PATCH team_ids [] -> 9. UI: team filter chips filter list, team-name row on card, New-tracker Team chips attach team, detail shows '<Team> only', Edit team chips switch Senior/Youth/All and members+totals update correctly; untagged trackers unchanged. Found 1 logic bug (stale off-team entries counted in team-scoped summary) and 1 robustness bug (PATCH team_ids:null -> 500 and corrupts tracker).

critical.issue: _summary() counts ALL entries (only excluded filtered), not just people in the team-scoped roster. Repro: create tracker (no team, $20), mark Coach Collab (not on Senior team) paid, PATCH team_ids=[Senior]. Result: paid_count 1/8, collected $20, short_count 7, outstanding $140 - expected 0/8, $160, short 8. UI then shows '1/8 paid' and 'Text who owes (7)' while all 8 listed members show 'owes $20'. Fix: pass the scoped roster ids into _summary and filter entries to member_id in that set (same applies to removed/other-season roster members).

minor.issue: Body {"team_ids": null} is stored as None -> PaymentTracker(**doc) ValidationError -> 500 on PATCH, and GET /payments/{id} + list then 500 for that tracker (list would break for the whole hub). Frontend always sends arrays so not user-reachable today. Fix: drop None values for list fields (exclude_none) or coerce to []. Same pre-existing risk for links/competition_ids/event_ids/photos.
team_ids not validated against the hub's teams; arbitrary ids accepted (tracker then has 0 members and card shows generic 'Team').
Allows recording payment for a roster member not on the tracker's team (returns 200) - creates exactly the stale entries that cause the bug above.

ui_bugs.component: Payments list empty state with team filter
ui_bugs.issue: When a team filter returns nothing, it says 'No payment trackers yet / Create one...' - misleading; should say 'No trackers for this team'.

integration_issues.issue: Header count/outstanding/'Text who owes (N)' can disagree with member list when an off-team member had a paid entry (backend _summary bug).

issues: 'Team (optional)' label is immediately followed by FilterChipRow's own 'TEAM' label - redundant double heading.
Filtering by a team hides whole-roster (untagged) trackers, even though they include that team's people - confirm this is intended.

action_items: HIGH: In team_payments._summary, only count entries whose member_id is in the tracker's scoped roster (pass roster id set from _tracker_roster_query); fix paid_count/collected/short/outstanding.
Coerce null list fields in PaymentTrackerUpdate to [] / drop them so PATCH {team_ids:null} cannot 500 and corrupt a tracker.
Optional: validate team_ids belong to hub teams; reject/ignore PUT member status for members outside the tracker's team(s).
Optional: team-filter-specific empty state text on /team/payments.
critical_code_review_comments: _excluded_in_roster ignores season scope while _roster_total applies it (pre-existing) - excluded_count can include other-season members.
list_payment_trackers runs one _excluded_in_roster count per tracker (N queries) - fine at current scale.
